integrity: Two standalone exact-integer, standard-library Python programs using distinct enumeration orders and overlap predicates, with output snapshots, provide reproducible finite exhaustive evidence. No external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: A complete exhaustive finite classification for minimal length up to 48, not a classification of all longer products. The length-48 witness and the maximum possible number nine were known; the new assertions establish length minimality, complete minimizer classification, and factorization uniqueness. Earlier unindexed computations might already contain the result.
title: The unique shortest overlap-free binary products of nine squares
